verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source (Apache-2.0) client-side 3D rendering engine distributed as npm packages. It runs in the user's own app, not as a vendor service that ingests customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it collecting user data or offering AI features that would make a training-data policy apply. The hosted Playground and Sandbox tools are not described as collecting or retaining user data for training.
